items.description: Daily Crypto lets you add crypto tokens to easily track their prices, price change & 24h highs and lows in your new browser tab! Tired of clicking through multiple sites, watchlists and more to track your crypto token prices? Daily Crypto replaces your default tab, and lets you easily access latest token prices of your curated selection of crypto tokens. From latest token prices, to price %age changes, 24 hour highs, lows and market cap ranks - we keep you updated.

A real-life Blockchain mashup, which allows you to SIGN and VERIFY digital files using the public (Bitcoin) blockchain. You can upload, free-of-charge, up to 5 objects at a time. This mashup uses the document and Blockchain possibilities of the Sphereon platform.

Welly is a mobile application that provides users their very own companion creature that travels with them and tracks their steps with the Fitbit activity monitor. It is an interactive activity game that makes workout simple and fun.
The Mashup allows you to search for Adobe Flex developer jobs based on your Zip code. Also you can SMS a job posting to your cell phone.
Intelligent agents based marketspace constantly aggregating top deals and rebates for a wide range of products.
vspotz is a hyper-local event search engine. Other available event search engines typically focus on major cities, however, vspotz is committed to having the most local search results.
A very fun Flickr game in which you view a set of ten images and try to guess the common tag. Time based scoring.
Cubit offers cut-and-paste ready planning data for a fee. Uses a Google Map to accept input of the area (free registration required).
A Google Gadget with a daily quote about first-time events recorded in sports, music, television, movies, politics, nature, history, fashion, fads, literature, science, and more.
Largest University crime map mashup, covering over 200 universities.
See if it will freeze in your area tonight. Uses HTML5 and is geolocation-enabled to quickly check weather conditions on mobile and desktop browsers.
A community to search, rate, and review local restaurants or find a new place to eat.
Search for jobs by city name. Mashup of Indeed and Google Maps.

SiteSummary Dashboard is a simple AngularJS web app that serves as a little demo created for the free SiteSummary API. It allows you to quickly see how many likes, shares, comments etc your site(s) have on various social media sites. You don't need to know AngularJS to use the dashboard -- simply add your URLs to the urls.txt file (one per each line, no commas) and open index.html. The dashboard also supports full text search. You can see an example dashboard at: http://fourtonfish.com/sitesummary-dashboard/demo/
Mapping based search to find German holiday rentals. Compare to find by location, like nearest one to the beach.
Displays satellite images of all 2010 Formula One Grand Prix Circuits with race results and grand prix information.

Create a scrapbook, family album, or other physical book using this web-based creation tool. Lets you integrate photos from Flickr. Click Start Book and then the Demo MemoryPress link to view a video that shows the mashup of Flickr and a user book.

FotoFuze is a professional 3D product photography and 2D image enhancement service. Make professional product photography out of ordinary photographs from ordinary cameras, for free, then add them to your Etsy listings.
Jobs Tractor searches twitter for developer jobs, ignoring recruiters and jobs boards. Tweets are displayed based on your location

GoldenDict aims to create a feature-rich dictionary lookup program. Uses WebKit for an accurate article representation, complete with all formatting, colors, images and links. Supports multiple dictionary file formats. Support for Wikipedia, Wiktionary or any other MediaWiki-based sites. Ability to use arbitrary websites as dictionaries via templated Url patterns. Pronunciations from forvo.com and many more features.
Crimelit guides you into the world of Stieg Larsson and others crimelit writers.
A simon game for telephone using DTMF tones.
A new experimental way to explore the Ile-de-France railway public transit system based on NAViTiA public transport information system API.
ErrorStack.com is a new online service designed to help developers manage and analyze their error data.
Find out what time around the world using Google Maps.
smugmug photos overlaid on top of Google Maps.
KnowledgeTreeLive is a hosted, on-demand edition of the KnowledgeTree Document Management Software to manage documents, secure documents, and collaborate.
Enter your postcode, how far to travel and what type of food you are looking for, and you will see all nearby food outlets in Northern Ireland.

Bitcoin Digital Downloads is a complete solution that allows you to automate the delivery of digital products after your customers pay you using Bitcoin. Bitcoin Digital Downloads can also be used as a Bitcoin payment terminal allowing you to receive Bitcoin payments for things like freelance or contract work, donations and more. Download links are encrypted to prevent unauthorized downloads and can also have an expiry time.
Shark the Market is an investor relations site using Twitter and Facebook.
Find local poker games, poker leagues, groups and players near you on this Google Map service.

Psykotube is a great way to browse lots of videos really quickly. With Really simple and neat interface. This is great to get an overall vibe of a search and is at times faster than youtube's own search tool!
An example of how to integrate the Twitter Streaming API, Pusher and Pusher WebHooks. More info at http://blog.pusher.com/2011/12/7/filtrand-a-demo-webhooks
A Google Gadget to notify you of the count of unread items in your Bloglines account.
See wikipedia articles faster and more economic in mobile devices. You can find and read any Wikipedia article more clearly and quickly on your mobile device.
PervWatch.org makes it easy for anyone to quickly find sex offenders in a graphical way. (Data availability varies by state.)
On this site, you can customize the video of a bag lunch puppet. The video customization requires only a single API call.
Shopify app that automatically tags product images with useful tags to improve shop SEO and conversion.

See where the US presidential candidates are on the campaign trail with this map. Timeline slider lets you see where they are now or will be in the future. Choose individual candidates, a state, and video.

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.
Get ice breakers (conversation starters) via SMS and be the life of the party.

TrashedTweet is an application that lets you call in and leave a 10 second voicemail when you're out drinking. The voicemail is transcribed by Twilio and then the transcription, along with a link to the recording, is tweeted from the @TrashedTweet twitter account.
